title: DEC-925 Reality Fracture prerelease: confirm the analysis approach

payload.prompt: Confirm the two-part process (pre-event archetype ranking by Monte Carlo + day-of pool evaluator) and answer four scoping questions. Full reasoning and verified facts are in my comment above.

questions.prompt: When is your prerelease event? (Arena launches 2026-09-29, so 17Lands data only exists for events on or after 2026-09-30.)
Which deliverable matters most? (multi-select; I will do all selected, in this priority order)

options.label: Pre-event ranking of the 10 pairs with probabilities (Monte Carlo over collation + graded cards)
One-page cheat sheet: key commons per color, tricks to respect, Jace-token and dual-land interaction
Day-of pool evaluator CLI: paste the pool, get top 3 builds with land split and splash
Just the graded card list (0 to 10 with role tags), no simulation

questions.prompt: Who builds the collation simulator and the pool evaluator scripts?

options.label: Engineer via child issue (default per the no-execution rule); CEO grades cards and writes the report
CEO does everything inline as a declared exception (faster, one owner)

questions.prompt: How should the card grades be produced?

options.label: Grade blind from oracle text first, then compare to Draftsim and limitedmtg and log disagreements (recommended)
Start from Draftsim grades, verify each against oracle text, correct with a reason
